title: Provenance records predict which multi-scale conclusions a foundation-potential release can change in SiGeC semiconductors
description: Code, data and figure scripts for the paper "Provenance records predict which multi-scale conclusions a foundation-potential release can change in SiGeC semiconductors" (Modelling and Simulation in Materials Science and Engineering (IOP)). Taylor D. Sparks acknowledges support from the Army Research Office Materials Design, under Contract No. W911NF-23-1-0333.
